extracted.intended_audience: data users, researchers, and engineers who consume or maintain the PatentsView bulk download data (patent analysts, bibliometricians, data librarians)
extracted.subtask_description: Documentation of structural and field-name revisions to the PatentsView bulk download dataset (granted patents and pre-grant publications), including table restructures, field renames, combinations/splits, and notes about removed/added fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardizing naming conventions across pre-grant publications and granted patents databases
rubrics_metrics.description: Standardizing naming conventions across the pre-grant publications and the granted patents databases
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document-wide objective stated in the Introduction; many tables and fields are renamed (see per-table 'Revised name' mappings) to follow consistent naming across datasets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Renaming data fields to be more informative
rubrics_metrics.description: Renaming data fields to be more informative of what the field contains
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Per-table 'Revised name' mappings present everywhere (e.g., application -> application_id, patent -> patent_id, text -> summary_text). The guidance is to prefer more descriptive field names (patent_id, pgpub_id, claim_sequence, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restructuring tables to reduce number of joins required
rubrics_metrics.description: Restructuring tables to reduce the number of joins required between tables to create data sets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple tables are combined or split (e.g., published_application + application + publication combined; assignee_disambiguated tables combined; inventor crosswalks combined) so common queries require fewer joins. Some tables removed entirely (archived on request).

rubrics_metrics.name: Archive removed tables on request
rubrics_metrics.description: These tables have been removed. Contact contact@patentsview.org to retrieve an archived copy of these data sets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If users need older/removed tables they must contact support to retrieve archived copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combine pre-grant publications application and publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Combine pre-grant publications application and publication into a new combined table published_application [pre-grant publications]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See new combined table name 'published_application' (formerly application and publication). This reduces need to join application + publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combine patent_assignee / publication_assignee into unified assignee tables and split by pre-grant vs granted
rubrics_metrics.description: Combine assignee_disambiguated and assignee tables across granted patents and pre-grant publications into new combined tables and split assignee.tsv to separate pre-grant & granted patent inventors/assignees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New combined tables: assignee [Pre-grant Publications & Granted Patents], with separate disambiguated and not_disambiguated forms; fields revised (see g_assignee_disambiguated/pg_assignee_disambiguated entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Combine patent_lawyer with lawyer into attorney_disambiguated
rubrics_metrics.description: Combine patent_lawyer with lawyer into attorney_disambiguated (disambiguated lawyer data)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New combined table includes attorney_sequence, attorney_id, disambig_attorney_name_first/last, disambig_attorney_organization, attorney_country (see g_attorney_disambiguated).

rubrics_metrics.name: Combine CPC group/subgroup/subsection into CPC title table
rubrics_metrics.description: Combine cpc_group, cpc_subgroup, and cpc_subsection into a single cpc_title table
rubrics_metrics.guidance: cpc_title will contain combined CPC classification title information with revised field names (cpc_class, cpc_subclass_title, cpc_group_title, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Combine patent_govintorg with government_organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Combine patent_govintorg with government organization into gov_interest_org (gov_interest_org / government_organization)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The new combined table maps government interest organization tags to patents/pre-grants with fields such as gi_organization_id, fedagency_name, level_one/level_two/level_three.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combine inventor crosswalks and split inventor.tsv by pre-grant vs granted
rubrics_metrics.description: Combine inventor disambiguation crosswalk tables (inventor_disambiguated and inventor_not_disambiguated) and create separate inventor tables for Pre-grant Publications & Granted Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New combined/disambiguated inventor tables include inventor_sequence and disambig_inventor_name_first/last; raw inventor tables have raw_inventor_name_first/last and rawlocation_id. See g_inventor_disambiguated and pg_inventor_disambiguated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add mainclass_current and subclass_current textual fields to USPC tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Add mainclass_current and subclass_current text fields to USPC tables
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enhances usability by providing textual current mainclass/subclass fields alongside numeric ids (see uspc_at_issue and related entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Combine wipo and wipo_field into wipo_technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Combine wipo and wipo_field into a new wipo_technology table
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The combined table contains wipo_field_sequence, wipo_field_id, wipo_sector_title, and wipo_field_title for each patent/pgpub (see g_wipo_technology and pg_wipo_technology).

rubrics_metrics.description: Table Description: WIPO technology classification of the patent or pre-grant publication; Final Data Field List includes patent_id/pgpub_id, wipo_field_sequence, wipo_field_id, wipo_sector_title, wipo_field_title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standardizes WIPO technology (sector/field) titles for both granted and pre-grant records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long Text tables — brf_sum_text, claims, detail description, draw description split by grant/pre-grant and chunked
rubrics_metrics.description: Long Text — List of Tables includes g_brf_sum_text_xxxx / pg_brf_sum_text_xxxx (summary_text), g_claims_xxxx / pg_claims_xxxx (claim_text with claim_sequence, dependent, claim_number, exemplary), g_detail_desc_text_xxxx / pg_detail_desc_text_xxxx (description_text and description_length), g_draw_desc_text_xxxx / pg_draw_desc_text_xxxx (draw_desc_sequence, draw_desc_text). Note: Many 'uuid' fields were removed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long textual fields (summaries, claims, descriptions, drawing descriptions) are separated into their own tables and have standardized field names (summary_text, claim_text, description_text, draw_desc_text) with explicit sequence numbers and length fields where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove Field 'uuid' across many tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Note repeated throughout: Field uuid was removed from many tables
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The dataset removes the old 'uuid' field in many tables; users must rely on the new canonical id fields (patent_id, pgpub_id, application_id, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use consistent key field names: patent_id, pgpub_id, application_id
rubrics_metrics.description: Canonical primary keys renamed/standardized across datasets to patent_id (granted patents), pgpub_id (pre-grant publications), application_id, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All tables use these canonical key names to allow consistent joins and reduce confusion from earlier inconsistent naming (e.g., document_number, id).
